paper_title: ToolFactory Automating Tool Generation by Leveraging LLM to Understand   REST API Documentations
caption: Training loss of APILLAMA. We applied moving average of window size 5 to smooth the training curve. Validation result is produced in every 20 steps.
model_annotation: The plot titled “Training and Evaluation Loss per Batch” illustrates loss values across training steps, showing a smoothed training-loss curve alongside periodically computed validation-loss values. The x-axis is labeled “Step,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 140 with regularly spaced tick labels every 20 steps. The y-axis is labeled “Loss,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0 up to about 2.8 with tick marks shown at 0.5 intervals. One line represents “Smoothed Training Loss per Batch” as a solid blue line with no markers; it starts near 2.7 at step 0, drops with fluctuations through the early steps (e.g., around 2.0–2.2 between roughly steps 2–12), then declines to around 0.6 by about step 30 and to roughly 0.35–0.4 by about step 40, after which it stays mostly between about 0.15 and 0.35 with a visible jump to around 0.6 near steps ~78–82 and another smaller rise near ~93–98 to around 0.45, ending near about 0.22–0.3 by the last shown steps (around 130–133). The second line represents “Validation Loss” as a solid orange line with no markers; it is shown at discrete step positions and connects those points, starting around 1.6 at step 20, decreasing to about 0.48 at step 40 and to about 0.35 at step 60, then remaining close to the low 0.3 range (around 0.33 at step 80, about 0.33 at step 100, about 0.31 at step 120, and about 0.30 at step 140).
